description: This file implements a Bluetooth peripheral server with custom GATT services, including handling connections, bonding, advertising, and pairing, using Zephyr RTOS Bluetooth APIs.

methods.name: read_signed
methods.description: Reads the signed_value variable over GATT.

methods.name: write_signed
methods.description: Writes to the signed_value variable over GATT.

methods.name: add_bonded_addr_to_filter_list
methods.description: Adds bonded device address to advertising filter list.

methods.name: bt_ready
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth, loads settings, manages bonding, and starts advertising.

methods.name: pairing_complete
methods.description: Handles pairing completion and reboots device after delay.
